• Current legal setting in myIR: invoice basis, six-monthly. The January start-period return is overdue; the February-July return is due 28 August 2026.
• Payments-basis figures are a comparison until IRD confirms the requested backdating/change.
• Bank statements and TradePilot can be combined as evidence, but larger or unclear purchases still need enough supplier, date, description and GST information.
• The Key Reviews sheet shows the few answers that can materially change the result; there is no need to attach every invoice to this workbook or to the GST return.
